description: Get a short-lived upload URL for a file the person already has (a PDF, Word file or image). Use this for an existing file; use hip_add_text_document for text you wrote with the person, or hip_set_letter for a letter in a handwriting-style font. Needs a job_handle from hip_create_job. Returns upload_url and required_headers: PUT the file's exact bytes there, then list it in hip_update_job's files. Send file_size, the file's exact size in bytes: the URL is signed for that size. File type and size limits are the same as the website.

content_type.description: optional: the file's MIME type, e.g. application/pdf. The upload URL is signed for it, so the PUT must send this exact Content-Type header (the result's required_headers). Left out, or not a plain type/subtype: application/octet-stream.

file_size.description: the file's exact size in bytes; the PUT must send exactly this many

filename.description: the document's file name with its extension, e.g. lease.pdf. The extension decides how it is read: PDF, Word (.doc or .docx), text, RTF, ODT, or an image (JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, GIF or WebP). Use the same filename in hip_update_job's files.

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

name: hip_get_upload_target
title: Get a document upload link
